questions.q: Which dance form is associated with Manipur?
questions.exp: Manipuri is the classical dance form of Manipur. It is known for its graceful movements and depicts themes of Vaishnavism. It was recognized as one of India's eight classical dances.

questions.q: The Ajanta Caves are famous for?
questions.exp: The Ajanta Caves (Maharashtra) are famous for their Buddhist paintings, sculptures, and rock-cut architecture. They date from the 2nd century BCE to about 480 CE and are a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

questions.q: Carnatic music is classical music of which region?
questions.exp: Carnatic music is the classical music tradition of South India. It is one of the two main subgenres of Indian classical music, the other being Hindustani music (North India).

questions.q: The Ellora Caves represent art from which religions?
questions.exp: The Ellora Caves (Maharashtra) contain 34 monasteries and temples representing Buddhism, Hinduism, and Jainism, built between 600–1000 CE. They are a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

questions.q: Bharatanatyam dance form belongs to which state?
questions.exp: Bharatanatyam is the classical dance form of Tamil Nadu. It is one of the oldest and most popular Indian classical dances, originating in the temples of Tamil Nadu.

questions.q: The famous Kumbh Mela is held at how many locations?
questions.exp: Kumbh Mela is held at 4 locations: Prayagraj (Allahabad), Haridwar, Ujjain, and Nashik. The Maha Kumbh Mela at Prayagraj occurs every 12 years and is the world's largest religious gathering.

questions.q: Which instrument is Ravi Shankar associated with?
questions.exp: Pandit Ravi Shankar was a world-renowned sitar player. He popularized Indian classical music globally and won three Grammy Awards during his career.

questions.q: The Konark Sun Temple is located in which state?
questions.exp: The Konark Sun Temple is located in Odisha. Built in the 13th century by King Narasimhadeva I, it is designed in the shape of a chariot with 24 wheels and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

questions.q: Yakshagana is a traditional art form of?
questions.exp: Yakshagana is a traditional theatre form of Karnataka that combines dance, music, dialogue, costume, and stage techniques. It is performed in coastal and central Karnataka regions.
